races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runner in this small field of hold-up horses, the early pace will be crawling as Holly Mist or potentially Tiger drift forward reluctantly. The lack of natural pace-setters means the field will bunch together through steady middle sections before exploding into a furious sprint from the 3-furlong pole. This tactical scenario heavily favours horses with genuine finishing kicks who can quicken off slow pace, putting hold-up specialists like Optician and Tiger at a significant advantage over those needing stronger gallop. The race shape decisively suits hold-up horses with proven sprint finishes.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Holly Mist sets pedestrian fractions and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy before unleashing devastating late kicks. Horses with proven finishing speed like Optician and Tiger can exploit their tactical edge when others have no kick left.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Gallop Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Tiger or Holly Mist inject more pace than expected through the middle sections
scenarios.body: A stronger gallop spreads the field and creates a more genuine test of stamina over the extended distance. This favours horses who can sustain their effort rather than relying purely on sprint finishes.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys refuse to commit early and leave everything until the final 2 furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a chaotic dash where positioning and traffic luck matter more than pure ability. Horses drawn favourably or with apprentice weight allowances gain crucial advantages in the scramble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pressure Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If one horse tries to steal the race by setting honest fractions from the start
scenarios.body: The pace-setter pays for their bold tactics as the hold-up brigade time their challenges perfectly. The strong early gallop sets up an ideal tactical scenario for the closers to pick off the leader.

races.paceDynamic: Rousham and Popty Ping emerge as the only realistic pace-setters, with Rousham showing clear front-running tendencies from his recent wins and Popty Ping capable of pressing if needed. With just one confirmed leader in a 16-runner handicap, Rousham should dictate a steady, uncontested gallop through the early stages before quickening from the 3f marker. This sustainable pace scenario heavily favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, particularly those with proven soft ground form like Circle Of Trust and Gunalt Wavelength. The race shape strongly benefits closers and hold-up performers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Rousham gets an easy lead with minimal pressure from Popty Ping.
scenarios.body: Rousham controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist late challengers, while the pace becomes too steady for hold-up horses to make up ground. Front-runners and prominent racers capitalize on the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Classic Closer Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate allowing multiple hold-up horses to get competitive.
scenarios.body: The soft ground plays to stamina types as Circle Of Trust, Gunalt Wavelength and Norfolk Blue unleash finishing kicks in the final furlong. Superior class horses from the rear divisions dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Tactical Move
scenarios.trigger: If Popty Ping or another prominent runner makes a bold move approaching the turn.
scenarios.body: The injection of pace stretches the field and benefits horses positioned in midfield who can respond immediately. Those held up too far back struggle to bridge the gap on the soft surface.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If both Rousham and Popty Ping fail to show early speed or encounter trouble.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl with a frantic sprint finish where any horse can win from any position. Bottom-weight improvers like Only Dream Big and Forever Twenty can capitalize on the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Alpha Capture will take them along from the front with Magic Boy, Highfield Viking, Beale Street and Wrydcroft all likely to race prominently in the early stages. With multiple prominent racers but no genuine speed merchants, the pace should be solid but not frantic over this 7f trip. The large field of 13 runners means those held up at the back like Jenever, Caragio and Tennessee Gold could struggle for racing room in the straight on soft ground. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good early positions and avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers maintain their early positions without excessive pressure
scenarios.body: The solid pace allows Magic Boy, Wrydcroft, and Highfield Viking to travel comfortably before quickening clear in the final furlong. The hold-up horses get caught in traffic and cannot make up the ground on testing soft turf.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Alpha Capture faces minimal early pressure and dictates terms
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader gets first run and holds off the challengers who leave their moves too late. Magic Boy and Beale Street provide the main threats but cannot reel in the front runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and racing room opens up late
scenarios.body: Jenever and Caragio find gaps in the straight to mount telling challenges from their hold-up positions. The early leaders tire on the soft ground after setting insufficient pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates serious interference and multiple hard luck stories
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with several horses unable to get clear runs, allowing an outsider like Tardaff or Green Pursuit to steal victory. The pace and positioning become irrelevant due to traffic problems.

races.paceDynamic: Berry Clever is the sole confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead with only Commander Of Life, Ziggy's Condor, and Bella Bisbee showing prominent tendencies but likely to settle just behind. The early pace will be controlled and sustainable given the lack of natural speed, allowing Berry Clever to dictate fractions without pressure. The majority of the field are hold-up horses including They All Know Me, Pulsar Star, Follow Your Heart, and Intervention, creating a bunched finish as they all need room to maneuver in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the early leader Berry Clever who can control the tempo, while prominent runners may struggle to bridge the gap between the lone leader and the wall of hold-up horses behind them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Berry Clever gets the expected uncontested lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: With no pace pressure early, Berry Clever can save energy and kick again when the hold-up brigade comes at him in the straight. His recent winning form at this trip and distance suggests he can sustain the advantage when not harassed early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the field bunches dangerously
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses creates traffic problems but one finds clear water and benefits from the sprint finish. They All Know Me's recent good form and David Nolan's 5lb claim could prove decisive in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Berry Clever weakens and prominent runners can position perfectly
scenarios.body: Commander Of Life or Bella Bisbee track the leader closely enough to strike when he tires but avoid getting swamped by the hold-up horses. The winner needs to time their challenge perfectly to get first run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Berry Clever goes too slow and gets swamped by multiple closers simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish with multiple hold-up horses hitting the line together in a blanket finish. The horse with the best turn of foot rather than position wins the day.

watchPoints.text: Berry Clever must break cleanly and establish position early - any hesitation allows prominent runners to pressure him
